headline: Foolish Burial
title: Foolish Burial Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Foolish Burial. What is it? It is a Normal Spell Card. What does it do? Send one monster from your Deck to the Graveyard. How do you use it? Many monsters have effects that work in the Graveyard, or you can send a strong monster there and then revive it with Monster Reborn or Call of the Haunted. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!

scenes.sub: Fuel for GY effects and revivals
